title: Comparative Analysis of Template-Based and Neural Network Approaches for Computer-Aided Retrosynthesis: ASKCOS vs. IBM RXN

contributions.purpose: 对比模板法(ASKCOS)与神经网络法(IBM RXN)逆合成表现
contributions.mechanism: 对乙酸乙酯/ε-己内酯/2,4,6-三溴苯胺三个目标分子,取各模型top-3路线,评人工可行性与文献支持
contributions.evaluation: 定性:ASKCOS偏文献支持、可解释路线(如Fischer酯化0.98);IBM RXN更灵活creative但有时不实用(top1为convoluted路线)
contributions.domain: 计算机辅助逆合成/合成化学
contributions.source_quote: ASKCOS generally excels at proposing literature-supported, interpretable synthetic routes, while IBM RXN demonstrates creativity and flexibility, occasionally at the expense of practicality

contributions.purpose: 指出两模型的共同覆盖缺口
contributions.mechanism: 检视ε-己内酯路线,发现均未提出经典工业法
contributions.evaluation: 负结果:两模型都漏掉环己酮的Baeyer-Villiger氧化(ε-己内酯最常用工业法),暴露数据库覆盖不足
contributions.source_quote: neither model suggested the classic Baeyer-Villiger oxidation of cyclohexanone, which is the most common industrial method for producing ε-caprolactone. This omission highlights a limitation in both models' coverage

contributions.purpose: 给出两模型最佳用例与改进方向
contributions.mechanism: 总结ASKCOS宜常规规划、IBM RXN宜创意探索;建议混合模型/数据库扩展/标准化基准/专家评审
contributions.source_quote: ASKCOS: Best for routine synthesis planning... IBM RXN: Useful for ideation and exploring alternative or creative routes
